rules.type: exact match with the intended event type
rules.title: contains the intended key phrase (case-insensitive) AND contains no date/time words (weekday, clock time, 'завтра', day + month name)
rules.datetime: starts_at equals the intended date and time exactly; null counts as wrong
rules.place: location_name contains the intended place stem (case-insensitive)
rules.dress_code: at least one dress-code item contains the intended stem (case-insensitive)
rules.actions_A: manual form: 1 entry action per key field = 5 actions per case
rules.actions_B: AI-assisted: 2 fixed actions (type the phrase, press the AI button) + 1 correction action per key field the draft got wrong
